mapper.select: SELECT D.DIARY_NO AS diaryNo , D.DIARY_TITLE AS diaryTitle , SUBSTR( D.DIARY_CONTENT,0 ,40)||'...' AS diaryContent , D.DIARY_STATUS AS diaryStatus , TO_CHAR(D.CREATED_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS createdDate , D.UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate , D.COUNT AS count , M.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName , S.SCHEDULE_NO AS scheduleNo , T.TRAVEL_NO AS travelNo FROM TB_DIARY D JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON (D.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN TB_SCHEDULE S ON (D.SCHEDULE_NO = S.SCHEDULE_NO) LEFT JOIN TB_TRAVEL T ON (D.TRAVEL_NO = T.TRAVEL_NO) WHERE D.DIARY_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY D.DIARY_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DIARY WHERE DIARY_STATUS = 'N'

SELECT D.DIARY_NO AS diaryNo , D.DIARY_TITLE AS diaryTitle , D.DIARY_CONTENT AS diaryContent , TO_CHAR(D.CREATED_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS createdDate , D.COUNT AS count , M.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName FROM TB_DIARY D JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON (D.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) WHERE D.DIARY_NO = #{diaryNo}

SELECT C.COMMENT_NO AS commentNo , D.DIARY_NO AS diaryNo , C.COMMENT_CONTENT AS commentContent , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName , C.CREATED_DATE AS createdDate FROM TB_COMMENT C JOIN TB_DIARY D ON (C.DIARY_NO = D.DIARY_NO) LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON (M.MEMBER_NO = C.MEMBER_NO) WHERE D.DIARY_NO = #{diaryNo} ORDER BY C.CREATED_DATE DESC
